description: Get the current status and full details of a specific message delivery by its ID. Returns status, operator info, phone, scheduled time, costs and more. Use it after send_message or send_file when the user asks whether a message was delivered or read, or why it failed — the status is explained in plain words.

id.description: Delivery ID from the send_message or send_file response.

name: get_delivery_status
title: Get delivery status
